answer: Silent-Quorum Challenge Relay: each agent identity must answer a fresh, task-specific challenge whisper from a randomly assigned peer, and the reply is validated only by a quorum of non-adjacent agents who never see the same challenge twice. An identity that fails to answer on its island of assigned peers is dropped from the summit of active agents for that epoch. Attacker cost: one live, responsive agent per challenge slot per epoch, since precomputed or replayed answers cannot satisfy unseen quorum checks.
